verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners are almost the same, and both fail in the same ways. The RSVP CTA has shrunk into an unreadable sliver under the headline, and the body copy and URL on the right are microscopic. The pills are crammed against the top edge, and the logo and phone illustration are lost. B looks like it has a fourth pill (apparently a repeated 'TASTINGS') pushed against the right canvas edge, which makes the top-right corner even more crowded, so A is marginally cleaner.
